name: GReminders
description: GReminders gives Claude secure access to your firm's scheduling, calendar, CRM, and client data. Claude can book and manage meetings, retrieve information from your CRM, answer questions about clients, financial information and firm data, and help advisors stay organized by bringing the right information together in one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GReminders to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GReminders to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.greminders.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GReminders MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GReminders provides these MCP tools: ask_anything, book_meeting, get_availability, get_contact, and get_event_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GReminders?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GReminders in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
GReminders requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GReminders is developed by GReminders. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
